data.title: CM wants 3 PRTS corridors tendered by December

slides.head: CM wants 3 PRTS corridors tendered by December
What happened
slides.body: Corridors: LB Stadium to Ranigunj via Tank Bund; Assembly Metro to Begumpet via Secretariat; KPHB Metro to Biodiversity via Durgam Cheruvu and Mindspace, per TOI.

slides.head: Why it matters
slides.body: The CM said the aim is to improve urban mobility and cut congestion, with speedy execution.

slides.head: PRTS corridors proposed
slides.body: Multi-level parking with PRTS depots is planned at Necklace Road and near IKEA, Gachibowli.

slides.head: Dig deeper
slides.body: The CM wants corridors finished within one year of work commencing.

slides.head: What to watch
slides.body: Whether tenders are floated by December as the CM directed. Ask: How will PRTS fares compare with metro and bus fares?

data.title: Sankranthi trains to AP sold out two months early

slides.head: Sankranthi trains to AP sold out two months early
What happened
slides.body: Godavari Superfast, Garib Rath, LTT Visakhapatnam and Visakha Express show REGRET in Sleeper; Gowthami, Cocanada and Narasapur are full or long-waitlisted, per TOI.

slides.head: Why it matters
slides.body: Railways open reservations 60 days ahead, and demand for the Sankranthi weekend to AP is far above seats.

slides.head: on AP trains for Jan 9-12
slides.body: SCR runs at least 100 trains between Telangana and AP, yet Jan 9-12 seats are gone; Mumbai, Delhi and Bengaluru trains still have berths.

slides.head: Dig deeper
slides.body: SCR operates at least 100 trains connecting Telangana with AP destinations.

slides.head: What to watch
slides.body: When SCR announces its Sankranthi special trains and extra coaches. Ask: How early will SCR announce Sankranthi specials this year?

data.title: Hyderabad beats Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru on clean-air efforts

slides.head: Hyderabad beats Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru on clean-air efforts
What happened
slides.body: Hyderabad scored 174.2 of 200 in the CPCB's Swachh Vayu Sarvekshan 2026 and ranked 19th among million-plus cities.

slides.head: Why it matters
slides.body: The survey scores how civic bodies tackle road dust, construction waste, vehicle and industrial pollution, and garbage.

slides.head: Swachh Vayu Sarvekshan 2026 score
slides.body: Among all India's 10-lakh-plus cities, though, it ranks only 19th, up three places.

slides.head: Dig deeper
slides.body: Greater Hyderabad was also named Telangana's first Swachh city in Swachh Survekshan 2025-26.

slides.head: What to watch
slides.body: How many of the NCAP-funded electric buses and EV charging stations actually roll out. Ask: Which parts of the city drag the score down: dust, traffic or waste burning?

data.title: Hyderabad had 1,372 lakes; nearly half are gone, says CM

slides.head: Hyderabad had 1,372 lakes; nearly half are gone, says CM
What happened
slides.body: The CM said the first phase of the Musi rejuvenation project would begin shortly and that no one would suffer losses.

slides.head: Why it matters
slides.body: He said lost water bodies broke natural drainage, leaving roads and colonies prone to flooding.

slides.head: lakes Hyderabad once had
slides.body: He says the Musi rejuvenation's first phase will begin shortly, but gave no start date.

slides.head: Dig deeper
slides.body: Thammidikunta, which had shrunk to 14 acres, was expanded to 30 acres, the CM said.

slides.head: What to watch
slides.body: An official start date and route for Musi rejuvenation phase one. Ask: Which lakes near you are on the list for restoration?
